about.heading: builder, student, adventurer.
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Roslyn. I'm based in the Bay Area, but originally from the East Coast. Every project on this site was built to solve a real problem, or just for fun.

I hold Bachelor's degrees in Computer Science and Business Management from Case Western Reserve University, and I'm currently pursuing my MBA at UC Berkeley Haas. Before business school, I spent 5 years as a Consultant at Deloitte, working with Big Tech clients on privacy and infrastructure/data center projects.

I enjoy staying active and spending time outdoors. Tennis is my favorite sport, and I'm currently working on improving my photography skills. I'm also on a mission to visit all 50 states and every national park.
